entry.title: Tri-Cut Spalted Tamarind Custom Cue with Torrefied Maple Shaft
entry.summary:
Vendor: Elite Cue
Type:
Price: 45000.00

Crafted for players who appreciate both performance and artistry, this custom cue blends premium materials with precision craftsmanship. The striking tri-cut Spalted Tamarind handle showcases the natural beauty of exotic wood, while the Ebony forearm and butt sleeve provide timeless elegance and exceptional durability. Finished with shimmering abalone inlays, every cue is handcrafted to stand out on and off the table.

Built for a smooth, consistent hit, it features a Torrefied Maple shaft that offers increased stability, reduced deflection, and excellent feedback. Combined with a Juma ferrule and Black Diamond tip, this cue delivers exceptional cue ball control, spin, and accuracy.

Specifications

  • Overall Length: 59 inches
  • Weight: 19 oz
  • Pin: Radial
  • Forearm: Ebony
  • Handle: Tri-Cut Spalted Tamarind
  • Butt Sleeve: Ebony
  • Inlays: Genuine Abalone
  • Shaft: Torrefied Maple
  • Tip Diameter: 12.5 mm
  • Taper: Pro Taper
  • Ferrule: Juma
  • Tip: Black Diamond

Features

  • Handcrafted using premium exotic hardwoods
  • Beautiful tri-cut Spalted Tamarind handle with unique natural grain
  • Elegant abalone inlays for a luxurious finish
  • Stable Torrefied Maple shaft for a crisp, consistent hit
  • Precision-machined radial pin for a solid, reliable joint connection
  • Smooth pro taper for effortless stroke and cue ball control
  • Built for serious players who demand performance without compromising style

Every Elite Cue cue is individually handcrafted, making each piece one of a kind. The natural wood grain ensures no two cues are ever exactly alike.
